exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosis using WHO 1999 criteria
Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosis using IADPSG criteria
cohort: The cohort consisted of 340 women booked for antenatal care at the Federal Medical Centre, Yenagoa, who consented to participate and underwent a 75-gram, 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test.
finding: The application of IADPSG criteria increased the incidence of GDM compared to WHO 1999 criteria (5.3% vs 3.8%), but this difference was not statistically significant, and there was no appreciable improvement in foetal and maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the rates of caesarean section or instrumental vaginal delivery between women diagnosed with GDM using IADPSG criteria versus WHO 1999 criteria.
